correctness.rationale: Explicit block-norm equality reduces to an additive matrix subspace. Same-side row-difference bounds and rank-one witnesses are sharp. The determinant sign is covered since \(p,q\ge2\). All quantifiers are analytic, not inferred from numerics; the standalone checker validates finite samples.

value.rationale: Exact evaluation of operator-commutator distance for all complete bipartite sizes is a natural missing class beyond path and general bound methods. The explicit dual norm solution quantifies spectral-distance decay as the graph grows, and the two part sizes control distinct within/across-part distances. The result supplies a structural rank-two matrix certificate and a complete family classification, not a routine isolated numerical table.
